primaryTextRead.text: The sons of Seir: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.
The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Jaakan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

wikipediaRead.title: List of minor Hebrew Bible figures, A–K
wikipediaRead.locator: A–K list lines 2646–2651, Ezer section: first item is Ezer son of Seir and father of Jaakan/Akan, cites 1 Chr 1:38/42; separately lists Ezer son of Ephraim and Ezer son of Jeshua.

wikipediaRead.identityAssessmentJa: The shared entry explicitly links this Seir-line Ezer to the two passages and distinguishes two other named Ezers.
